description: Three parallel crackle voices through a shared drive, a modulo wrap and a sample-rate degrader, mixed to one output

params.text: Sets the pitch of that voice
Sets how deeply a sample and hold noise source modulates that voice
Sets how far that voice is morphed from a sine towards harder and brighter shapes
Sets the saturation applied to the three voices together, none at the far left
Sets how far the mix is wrapped back on itself, none at the far left and the wrap growing as it is turned
Sets how coarsely the mix is resampled; the control is wired backwards, so fully anticlockwise leaves the signal alone and turning clockwise degrades it
Sets the level leaving the module, silent at the far left and twice unity at the far right
Sets that voice's level into the mix

inputs.text: Adds to that voice's harm knob
Adds to that voice's n.mod knob
Adds to that voice's freq slider
Adds to that voice's gain trim

outputs.text: The three voices mixed, driven, wrapped and degraded, one channel

notes: every CV jack here adds a fifth of its voltage to the knob and the total is held between 0 and 1, so five volts covers the whole of a knob's travel
a polyphonic cable patched to any CV jack is read on its first channel alone
the module adds nothing to Rack's right-click menu in this build
